instructions_to_main_agent: Priority surface is the POS Cash Register in landscape tablet orientation. Ensure layout is 100vh locked without window scrollbars; inner scroll regions for products and cart.
Enforce high-contrast dark theme (#0F0B1E background, #1A1333 cards, #EC4899 pink accents, #8B5CF6 violet glows).
All touch targets (buttons, product cards, category tabs, numpad keys) must have minimum height of 48px to 64px for fast cashier tapping without miss-clicks.
Implement real-time cart math (subtotal, percentage/amount discounts, 20% French VAT, item addition/subtraction, line deletion).
Payment drawer/modal MUST feature a working virtual numpad for cash, quick exact bill buttons (+10€, +20€, +50€, Appoint exact), and change calculation ('À rendre').
Provide store switcher in top header (Pouzauges vs Chantonnay) and cashier switch PIN overlay.
Include sample seed data for French vape items (Red Astaire 50ml, Sub Zero 10ml, Kit Drag X, Coils GTX 0.2, Booster Nicotine 20mg, Base DIY 50/50 1L).
Secondary back-office pages (Ventes, Produits, Stock, Clients, Statistiques, etc.) must be accessible via top/side drawer menu without disrupting active sales.
Every key interactive element MUST carry a descriptive data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='pos-product-card', data-testid='pos-cart-payment-btn', data-testid='numpad-btn-20').
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT make generic white centered layouts or dull Bootstrap columns.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for modals, headers or floating popovers.
Always specify precise hover/focus states with contrasting text colors.
Ensure all buttons and inputs have clear data-testid attributes.
Use sonner for instant cashier notification toasts (e.g., 'Produit ajouté au panier', 'Remise appliquée', 'Vente enregistrée').
